title: Deploying models: batch, real time and at the edge

videos.script: A model in a registry helps nobody. It has to answer somebody, somewhere, in time to be useful. {{registry}} There are three places it can answer. {{three}} In a nightly batch, where every member gets a score before marketing wakes up. {{batch}} In a web service, where one member gets a score while their page loads. {{service}} Or on the device itself, a phone or a till, where there may be no network at all. {{edge}} Ponto Final's voucher list needs the first. The member page wants the second. And a till that keeps working when the shop's internet drops would need the third. {{needs}} This lesson builds all three, from the same champion. Three thousand three hundred scores in a table, a service that answers in milliseconds, and a file under two kilobytes that runs without Python. {{build}} Then the question every deployment ends on. How do you put a new version in front of real members without betting all of them on it? {{canary}} One member in ten. {{ten}}
